d: Wild Lido of Sicily near Mount Etna. Galatea and Calipso arrive in them basins and courted by Ninfe, Tritoni and sea gods at the dawn.
While Galatea wants to leave, Polyphemus appears from a leap of the mountain.
The ships of Ulysses come from afar, and one arrives. Ulysses and his Companions land, and then Aci and sayings.
Another part of the lido with fishermen's huts. Calipso in fisherman's dress, Nerea his nymph in appearance of fisherman in his boat, and then Ulysses.
